$comment: The deployment record. PRD §17 keeps addresses out of apps/ and packages/;
they live here and in DEPLOYMENT.md, and are read at runtime from the
environment. This file is the record, not a source of compiled-in constants.
The live deployment is the P3 one below. The P1/P2 deployment it supersedes
is kept under `supersededDeployment` because its 29,541-sample run is still
the evidence behind several claims, and deleting the addresses would make
that run unverifiable. Both are on chain; only one is current.

accounts.$note: Two accounts by design — DECISIONS.md D-019. In the P3 run the deployer was also the witnessed trader.

$note: The breach here was not staged. The live third-party book sat at a spread
of roughly 22000 against a committed maximum of 15000 for the whole
window, so the commitment was simply wrong about the book it described.
The maker never had to withdraw anything.
Measured, not estimated: 33 STT funded, 15.981404136 recovered by sweep,
6028 samples written. The P2 handler cost 0.001286 per sample; this one does
more work per callback because it decodes OrderPlaced and OrderFilled as well
Breaches stop at 1396 because the window closed; every sample after that is
WINDOW_CLOSED, which is not a breach and is not coverage.
SubscriptionCleared(18103719, acknowledged=true). This is the D-044 fix
exercised on chain: the same call on the superseded subscriber reverts
AlreadySubscribed and can never be cleared, while this one cleared and now
refuses only for InsufficientBalance — it would subscribe again if funded.
A witness is the join of two pool logs: OrderPlaced carries the owner but
no fill, OrderFilled carries the quantity but no address. The subscriber
forwarded both halves and the registry joined them on order id at claim
time. The sole witness took the whole bond, pro-rata over a witnessed

evidence.$note: A reactive transaction: from and to are both the subscriber, and the nonce is the block-unique reactivity nonce.

$comment: The P1/P2 deployment. Still on chain and still verifiable; its run is the
evidence for the 29,541-sample measurement. Superseded because both the
registry's subscriber and the subscriber's commitment are immutable, so
adding settlement meant deploying the pair again (DECISIONS.md D-047).
Its subscriber is also permanently wedged — see D-044.
